listing_info.listing_name: Wolfeboro Lakeside Home with breathtaking views
listing_info.description:
Located at the tip of Springfield Point, this house offers the best views of Lake Winnipesaukee sunsets and the surrounding mountains! Enjoy the lake, with 185 feet of waterfront, a small sandy beach, lakeside lawn, and a swimdock where you can lounge all day in full sun. The property includes a boathouse, breakwater with docks with protected docking for up to three boats. This is the home to make memorable family summer gatherings.
7 night booking required, Saturday to Saturday. Summer only

The space
This home offers two master suites, other flexible sleeping arrangements, a kid-friendly beach, great entertaining spaces with patios and a gas grill and two full laundry setups . TVs are in the Living Room, two master bedrooms, kitchen and downstairs in game room.

Guest access
Guests have full and private access to the house, docks and property.

Other things to note
Pets are permitted

listing_info.listing_name: Bear Island Dockhouse - Paddle, Swim & Trails

listing_info.description: Relax with the whole family at this spacious home that features a charming farmer’s porch on the front and a bright screened in porch off the back. Nestled in a quiet area, it’s just half a mile from the public boat launch and the town beach, and includes convenient parking for a boat. The perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

listing_info.listing_name: Wolfeboro Waterfront Oasis. w/ Dock & Beach!
6BR Lakehouse Retreat, Beach Access, Day Dock
listing_info.description:
Perfect for families and friends, our spacious retreat offers beach activities in summer, hiking, skiing, and ice fishing. Relax and unwind at this peaceful lakeside escape. Plus, a private beach is just 5 minutes walk! Book now and take advantage of this exclusive offer before it’s gone!

The space
We bought this charming lake house as a perfect year around retreat to raise our lively twin boys. The spacious layout provides stunning views, plenty of room to unwind or socialize, and a private beach just a 5-minute walk away.

As passionate travelers, we know how important it is to create lasting memories with loved ones. That’s why we’re excited to share our home with fellow adventurers who value the joy of spending time with family and friends.

Guest access
Guests have access to the full house including the private beach. Per association rules, max number of guests at the beach is limited to 10 guests/house. In season the day dock is available for up to a maximum of 1 hour per day.

Other things to note
This is a new home for us, and while we’ve made a lot of improvements and are still adding the final touch-ups, we’re continuing to learn more about the house. We’d love your feedback and suggestions as we work to make it our perfect home. We also hope you love our home as much as we do.

Tucked at the end of a private, wooded road in a quiet cove, this 1960s charmer underwent main level renovations, including the kitchen, in 2022. The open layout offers western-facing lake views from most rooms. Outside you'll have two large private docks, one perfect for sunbathing, fishing and eating meals, and the other for docking your boat. Enjoy the large sandy beach, fire pit, expansive lawn & spectacular sunsets five minutes from charming Wolfeboro Main Street.

The space
Winter Harbor is a coveted Winnipesaukee cove known for stunning views and calm water. The home has a spacious kitchen, dining tables inside and out, laundry, two family rooms with large sectionals, a wood burning fireplace inside, a fire pit outside, and five bedrooms (including an entry level bedroom with queen bed ). Don't miss the wild blueberry bushes by the docks!

*Please note The brown cabin pictured is part of the property, but is not set up for guest use at this time.

Guest access
You have the entire main house and grounds available to you!

We do ask that guests do not use the smaller buildings on the property, which include a detached garage, shed, and small brown cabin. The hot tub will be shut down and unavailable.

Other things to note
Please note that this is our personal vacation home and a very special place to us. We love to host families and respectful groups, but parties and additional guests beyond those mentioned at booking are not permitted. Limit 3 cars at any given time. Thank you, and enjoy!

listing_info.listing_name: Family focused, modern lake side 60’s cottage!
listing_info.description:
Our 3 bedroom, plus a kid bunk area rental is on the upper two floors of our home which also includes a separate, private garden apartment. This rental is best suited for up to 3 couples and then additional children about 10 years and younger. The garden apartment is not a part of this rental, but it should be noted that our family may or may not be staying during one’s rental.

Guest access
Guest have access to the upper two floors and a shared laundry area located in the basement. Guest can use the yard, the driveway off the front door entrance and the front deck including grill. Off limits is the parking area associated with the garden apartment.

Other things to note
Please note, this is our home and not a party or event house. It is best suited for up to 6 adults sharing king size beds and up to 6 children in bunks and/ in addition toddler/ babies in appropriate and provided pack and plays/ cots, etc. if the makeup of your party exceeds this, our home which is on a septic system and has a limit to it’s capacity, is not a good fit for you.

Adult guest will not be permitted to bring their own air mattresses or be able to plan to sleep on sofas at night. It is also strongly advised that guest don’t plan to sleep on bunk beds as they aren’t weighted for adults.

Our home is on a quiet, woodsy dirt road in a family oriented home owners association. While the neighborhood is very wooded, homes are relatively close to one another and NOT isolated. Be mindful and respectful in terms of noise of others who are here to unwind. Relaxation is just steps away at the private beach or feel free to unwind indoors in one of three living rooms or outside on the deck or large grass yard! If you need a little taste of town, Center Harbor and Meredith are 15-20 minutes drive away!

listing_info.listing_name: Dreamy Lakefront Getaway, Beach, Skiing,Hiking GIC
listing_info.description:
Tucked away on a quiet shore of Lake Winnipesaukee, this stunning - 4 bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Gilford home on Governor's Island boasts 100’ of waterfront beach, deck overlooking the lake, and plenty of sleeping arrangements - ideal for a peaceful getaway with all your loved ones. By day, enjoy swimming, kayaking and games on the sandy beach. Conclude each evening with s'mores by the fire, a board game around the dining room table and dinner overlooking the lake!"

The space
Contemporary Cape style house built in 1986 with beautiful unique rooms. Spacious open concept with views of the lake from almost any angle. Large 10-person table great for families. Pool table in large family room.

Guest access
Guest will have the entire home to themselves. The attached garage, detached garage and master bedroom closet with be locked off for supply storage. Guests will not have access to those areas.

listing_info.listing_name: Lakefront Log Cabin, Private Sandy Beach, Hot Tub
listing_info.description:
Come & enjoy lakefront living. We are in a lovely, tranquil cove, but also just a short kayak, canoe or boat ride away from the busier and deeper parts of our 800 acre, 5 mile long lake! Our private, sandy beach is 100' long and perfect for the kids! We have 3 bedrooms (1 king and 2 queens), and 3 bathrooms.
We also have a finished basement that will sleep 6. We have two indoor propane fireplaces.

And there is nothing like an outdoor shower with our brand new, closed-in outdoor wood shower!

The space
Private 100' sandy beach, with a lovely dock for swimming, fishing, sunning, et al. Beach water is quite shallow for several feet out, making it perfect for little children and those learning to swim.

The house has 3 formal bedrooms, with 4 queen beds (there are two queen beds in the master bedroom). In addition, the finished basement has 3 day beds and 3 trundles.

There are two bathrooms upstairs — one attached to the master bedroom, one off the kitchen next to the 2nd bedroom, and one in the finished basement.

Feel free to use our new hot tub right next to house anytime. Please use the outdoor shower first to rinse dirt and sand off your feet before entering the hot tub. There is also a grey bucket near the hot tub if you want to test the water and/or add chemicals based on the readings of the water.

Thank you.

Note: We only rent with either 7 night stays (F-F) or 4/5 night stays (S/M-F) from mid-June through Labor Day. We are happy to rent weekends during the other 9 1/2 months of the year (with a 3 night minimum on holiday or premium weekends). Thanks for your understanding!!

Guest access
You will have use of our 2 kayaks and canoe, other flotation devices and the tiki hut on the beach, and any games we have (e.g. KanJam).

Feel free to use our new hot tub and all of our tables and chairs on the beach an at the fire pit area behind the cabin.

We recently redid our entire kitchen. Enjoy it, use the pots, pens, utensils, dishes and glasses, but please put them back clean prior to leaving. Feel free to use the dishwasher.

Please treat things well and put them back when finished using them. Ensure that the water level of the hot tub is at indicated mark on the inside of the tub.

Before you leave, please strip all the beds that we were used and put the dirty linens in the master bathroom to be washed, dried, and folded by our cleaning crew.

Thank you.

Other things to note
I will check in with you on your date of arrival to ensure you are happy and satisfied and answers any questions, but I will not plan on being available in person. Also available by email and cell phone during the stay for any questions.

Also, please be aware that noise travels quickly and very loudly across the water. So, please be considerate of our neighbors. We do not want to upset anyone with loud noise after 10pm on any night (or before 8am in the mornings). And a reminder that fireworks are illegal in the Town of Wakefield. Thank you!!
